svg.title: Economic feedback hypothesis for merchant reserve decisions
svg.desc: Authored proposed architecture or illustrative scenario. See the companion system design for scope and limitations.

g.text: 3. The hypothesis: reserve policy can change the risk it covers
A causal proposal to test, not an established effect. Agents investigate mechanisms; the evaluator measures outcomes.

g.text: Is the constraint cash, capacity, timing, or evidence?
Which additional test could overturn the recommendation?

g.text: New observations inform the next review; spent funds cannot be restored by resetting the reserve.
Controls: same demand, supply capacity, customer promise and information budget. Track effects on other merchants and unresolved liabilities.

polyline.style: stroke: rgb(79%,83%,87%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: None; fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: A reserve release is a balance reclassification. Merchant sales are not PayPal revenue; neither metric establishes provider savings.
Research basis: completed Aftershock report, 19 October 2026. Not an official PayPal design.
